text_block_list.text:
There was an exhibition for a picture book author Rice Shower likes,
so we went to see it together...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Big Brother...
For listening to Rice's wish.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Big Sister...
For listening to Rice's wish.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I got to see that painting of the moonlit beach.
I really love how shadows were used in that piece...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that even shadows can be beautiful...
it somehow gave me courage...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... If I close my eyes, that painting
almost floats right back behind my eyelids—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother...? Huh?
Where is this... Don't tell me Rice—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister...? Huh?
Where is... Is this place, by any chance, where Rice—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Did I get trapped inside a painting...?
W-W-W-What should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Someone's there...
U-Um—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...? Is that... me?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on a second...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...
Wait, I just want to talk...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: (Still, that running... If only Rice could run like that too...)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(...No. If that were me,
I'm sure I could run just like that...!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: (Just one more step... Just a little more—)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Big Brother...? Wait...
Was that... all just a dream?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Big Sister...? Wait...
Was that... all just a dream?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-No... it's nothing. Just that—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I was kinda hoping you'd join me for some training now...!

Afterward, when I accompanied her in training,
her running, for some reason, had gained an extraordinary sharpness...
